open_points.subject: INV-009 repeated re-assignment and re-grant history
open_points.text: a pair whose only record is revoked receives a new active record and the revoked one is unchanged
open_points.question: What must the Required tests show when a pair has two or more revoked historical records and no active record: must another new active record be created while every revoked record remains unchanged?
options: Require repeated revoke-and-create cycles for staff assignments, viewer grants and producer grants, proving that any number of revoked records may coexist with one new active record.
Test only the single-revoked-record case, leaving behavior with multiple revoked records to later implementation.
open_points.default_guess: Require repeated cycles for all three record kinds; any number of revoked records may remain while exactly one new active record is created.

witness.initial: A staff/project pair has two revoked StaffProjectAssignment records and no active assignment.
events: An administrator calls assign_staff_project for that pair.
outcomes: A new active assignment is created and both revoked assignments remain unchanged.

The operation refuses or fails because the implementation assumed that at most one historical record exists; the stated Required test still passes because it covers only a pair whose only record is revoked.
witness.observer: The administrator and any authorization check for that staff/project pair.

open_points.subject: active-pair duplicate failure contract
open_points.text: a pair with an active record is refused and nothing changes; and the storage refuses a second active record for a pair inserted past that check
open_points.question: What failure may callers rely on when an active duplicate is detected, and must a storage uniqueness collision caused by a concurrent request be translated to the same failure?
options: Expose one duplicate-active conflict for both the operation check and a storage collision.
Expose a domain duplicate refusal for the operation check but a distinct persistence/concurrency failure for a storage collision.
Expose only an undifferentiated refusal in both cases.
open_points.default_guess: Expose one duplicate-active conflict in both paths while preserving atomic no-change behavior.
consequences: One failure makes sequential and concurrent duplicate attempts observationally consistent and prevents persistence details from escaping.
Distinct failures let callers observe whether the duplicate was found before insertion or arose from a race.
An undifferentiated refusal preserves concealment but gives callers no stable duplicate-specific result.
open_points.requirement: INV-009: at most one active record per (staff_id, project_id) assignment, per (viewer_id, project_id) grant and per (service_principal_id, project_id) grant; revoked records of the pair stay, and a new grant after revocation is a new record

witness.initial: A pair has no active record, and two administrators concurrently submit creation requests for it.
events: Both operations pass the active-record check.
The second insert reaches the storage uniqueness constraint.
outcomes: The second caller receives the same duplicate-active conflict that a later sequential request would receive.
The second caller receives a persistence or concurrency failure distinct from the ordinary active-duplicate refusal.
witness.observer: The second administrator or API client.

open_points.subject: concurrency security-review coverage after INV-009 moved from A8 to A3
open_points.text: concurrency: APPLICABLE; references: A8, A18, A19, A22, A29; affected: replay identities, single active budget version, bootstrap
open_points.question: Must the concurrency review now reference A3 and name the single-active assignment and grant guarantee, or is INV-009 intentionally excluded from this security category despite A31 claiming a total review?
options: Add A3 and single-active staff assignments, viewer grants and producer grants to the concurrency category.
Declare explicitly that INV-009 is not part of the concurrency review and give the project-specific rationale.
Leave the existing A8 reference as if it still owned INV-009.
open_points.default_guess: Add A3 and explicitly include the three single-active record constraints; retain A8 for its remaining replay identities.

witness.initial: INV-009 has moved from A8 to A3, while A31's concurrency row still references A8 and does not reference A3.
events: A later reviewer follows A31's concurrency references.
The reviewer inspects A8, which now contains only replay identities, and does not inspect A3's assignment and grant uniqueness rule.
outcomes: The review treats concurrent creation of assignments and grants as covered through A3.
The review silently omits that concurrency guarantee because its recorded references remain unchanged.
witness.observer: The security reviewer and later agents relying on A31's claimed total review.
